newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower on crop boosting rains.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower on crop boosting rains.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower as crops in the Dakotas and Montana received much needed rains with more showers forecast, dealers said.
"It is going to cover a lot of the dry spots. Things are looking better out there," one dealer said.
Active inter-market spreading was also noted with interest centered on selling MGE wheat and buying either KCBT or CBOT wheat futures.
Featured sellers included LFG (2.4 million bushels of September). Traders said LFG also bear spread 3.5 million bushels of Dec/Sept from 4.5 cents to eight cents.
July closed 6-1/4 cents a bushel lower at $3.65-1/2. Other months were off 6-1/4 to two cents.
